title: Will/wits social checks can be retried immediately and as many times as wanted on failure for only the cost of one turn, with no stated penalty — unlike grace/might physical checks, which frequently show an explicit 'fail costs Xhp.' E.g. asking Widow Kestrel for the sailors' verse failed on a roll of 6, then succeeded next turn on a roll of 19, at no cost beyond the extra turn.
where: Widow Kestrel's House, Gullhaven; also Prior Halm, Fenmarch Priory
